pages.title: Bunker
pages.text: $(l)Health$(): 400$(br)$(l)Damage$(): 12, every 0.61 s, range 6$(br)$(l)Cost$(): 100 minerals$(br)$(l)Build time$(): 29 s$(br2)$(o)StarCraft II numbers (LotV).$()

pages.title: Abilities
pages.text: $(l)Salvage$(): Takes the bunker down in 5 s: its garrison walks out, 75 % of its cost back$(br2)$(l)Load$(): Takes aboard own ground units of its race nearby: a flyer 8 slots, a bunker 4 (6 with neosteel), a command center 5 SCVs, a nydus any zerg$(br2)$(l)Unload$(): Flies there and puts the cargo down; a building lets it out (a nydus the cargo of all its ends); a click on a rider in the panel lets it out alone
